race.comment: WEASEL SEA (5) is back from a break of five months. Yet to miss the placings in four starts and looks ready to go off a recent jumpout win. Hasn't put a foot wrong to date and drawn well, will take catching. EXTREME TURBO (12) is a gelding by Pinatubo on debut for the Laurie yard, out of a handy mare in Extreme Bliss. Has jumped out quite well and should take beating from the inside gate. STOMPING GROUND (13) ran a solid race first up at Warracknabeal to grab fourth. Better for that and up in trip will suit. TIKIELA (11) has had a few chances but is going okay and could sneak a placing from SHORTCAKE (8), an Exceed And Excel mare who has jumped out quite well.
